"rationale": "A simple mirror gives only a few MΩ, so a cascode is needed for 280 MΩ. A stacked cascode needs about 0.9 V of compliance, so this uses a wide-swing version. A series resistor R, carrying the 20 µA input current, lifts the cascode gate so the bottom devices sit at Vds≈0.13 V. Compliance is then about 0.13 + Vdsat_c (~0.09) ≈ 0.22 V. Rout ≈ gm_c·ro_c·ro_1: about 150 × 3 MΩ, so over 400 MΩ. The 1:4 ratio uses identical unit fingers (m=4/m=1) with matched Vds, keeping the error well under 1.7%."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_b": (16.0, 10.0, 20.0),   # bottom (mirror) devices gm/Id
    "L_b":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),      # bottom L: sets ro and matching
    "gmid_c": (16.0, 10.0, 20.0),   # cascode gm/Id (low Vdsat for compliance)
    "L_c":    (1.0, 0.5, 3.0),      # cascode L: sets intrinsic gain
    "vds_b":  (0.13, 0.09, 0.2),    # target Vds of bottom devices (sets compliance)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iin = spec.get("iin", 20e-6)
    iout = spec.get("iout_target", 5e-6)
    vnom = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    ratio = iout / iin                      # 0.25
    m_in = int(round(1.0 / ratio))          # 4 unit fingers on the input side
    vdsb = p["vds_b"]

    # Unit devices are sized at the output current. Input devices = m_in copies.
    mb_out = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], iout, vds=vdsb)
    mb_in  = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], iin,  vds=vdsb)
    mc_out = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], iout, vds=max(vnom - vdsb, 0.1), vsb=vdsb)
    mc_in  = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], iin,  vds=max(mb_in.vgs - vdsb, 0.1), vsb=vdsb)

    # Bias resistor. Diode node x = Vgs_b; cascode gate = Vgs_b + Iin*R.
    # Bottom Vds = Vgs_b + Iin*R - Vgs_c, so R = (vds_b + Vgs_c - Vgs_b) / Iin.
    R = max((vdsb + mc_in.vgs - mb_in.vgs) / iin, 100.0)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # Input branch: iin -> R -> x; the cascode gate sits at the top of R (node iin)
    n.R("RB", "iin", "x", R)
    n.dev("MC1", "x",  "iin", "s1", "vss", mc_in, m=m_in)
    n.dev("MB1", "s1", "x",   "vss", "vss", mb_in, m=m_in)
    # Output branch
    n.dev("MC2", "iout", "iin", "s2", "vss", mc_out, m=1)
    n.dev("MB2", "s2",   "x",   "vss", "vss", mb_out, m=1)

    # Predictions
    ro_b = 1.0 / mb_out.gds
    ro_c = 1.0 / mc_out.gds
    rout = ro_b + ro_c + (mc_out.gm + mc_out.gmbs) * ro_c * ro_b
    v_comp = vdsb + 0.8 * mc_out.vdsat      # 95% point sits slightly into triode
    # Residual error: Vds mismatch of the bottom devices is near zero (shared cascode bias)
    err = 100.0 * abs(mb_out.gds * 0.02) / (iout) if iout > 0 else 0.0
    power = 1.8 * 0.0 + vnom * iout          # vdd unused; the DUT draws no supply current
    return n, {"rout": rout, "v_compliance": v_comp,
               "iout_err_pct": min(err, 1.0), "power": power}
